function.name: terminal_command
function.description: Run a Python or shell command in the isolated user-file container. Read, create or edit complete documents. No network access. At most 30 seconds per command.

function.name: publish_document
function.description: Verify an output file and return its authenticated downloadable link. Supports DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF/CSV/MD/PNG in the current request directory.

strategy.description: The actual operation used: new file, reconstruction from content, or modification preserving unrequested formatting.
